==Training==
In this low-tech workshop dwarves can train their strength, agility, toughness, spatial sense, kinetic sense and willpower [[cv:attribute|attribute]]s. For this reason the "Athlete" [[cv:skill|skill]] was introduced, even if this skill is at legendary level, the attributes can still be increased.

There are three variations on the way dwarves can work out:

*Easy - trains using any bar
*Medium - trains using a metal bar
*Hard - trains using a lead bar

A harder workout will raise the attributes faster.
